common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to pick up right where you left off.

pa.placeholderBody: Say hi to get started — type, or tap the mic and just talk. I can chat, manage reminders, and once you connect Google in Settings, handle your email and calendar too. Research and reaching out to people for you are coming soon. Message me here or on WhatsApp, it's the same conversation either way.
pa.recordHint: Recording… tap the arrow to send
pa.micPermission: Microphone access is needed for voice notes.
pa.researchTitle: Here's what I found — pick one
pa.researchNotBooked: Nothing is booked or paid for yet. Confirming just tells me which one you want — you complete the booking through the link.

board.setupBody: Describe your business in your own words — what you do, who your clients are, and what you'd like to keep track of. I'll turn it into a board with the right fields and a follow-up rule. You can write in English or Hebrew.
board.setupPlaceholder: e.g. I'm a therapist. I see clients weekly or every two weeks, I note how many sessions they've paid for, and I want a nudge if someone hasn't booked in 3 weeks.
board.setupWorking: Reading your description and building the board — this takes about half a minute.
board.overviewFollowUpNote: Automatic flags aren't switched on yet — the rule is saved here, ready for when they are.
board.listEmpty: No {{noun}} yet — add your first one and they'll show up here.
board.formDateHint: Opens a calendar to pick the date
board.detailNoDetails: No details yet — tap the pencil to add some.
board.historyPlaceholder: What happened? A recap of the {{session}}, a note, anything worth remembering…
board.historyEmpty: Sessions and notes you log will show up here, newest first.
board.deleteConfirmBody: This removes their record and history from the board. It can't be undone.
board.historyExplainer: What happened, and when. Each {{session}} you log here keeps their record up to date.
board.notesExplainer: Anything you want to remember about them. Add to it whenever — for something that happened on a day, use the history below.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartNotice: The app will restart to apply the new layout direction.
settings.whatsappExplainer: Link your WhatsApp number to chat with me there too — it's the same conversation either way.
settings.googleExplainer: Connect your Google account so I can read, draft and send email for you, and check or add to your calendar.
settings.googleConnected: Connected as {{email}}. I can handle your email and calendar now.
